extraction: Computed by scripts/los_depth_argument.py; FlatLambdaCDM H0=70 Om0=0.3.
note: DERIVED, not downloaded. Answers the brief question of which member-galaxy coordinates are measured. x_a and y_a (transverse, from RA/Dec) are measured to 0.15-0.64 kpc. z_a (line-of-sight depth) is NOT measured and cannot be: 1 Mpc of real depth produces only 5-9 percent of the measured velocity dispersion in observed cz, and reading the dispersion as Hubble flow would imply a spurious depth 3.2-4.7 times the cluster diameter. The downstream code must sample z_a and marginalise. sigma_v values are literature values cited per cluster and used only to set the scale; nothing is fitted.
